title: sse: fix streaming chunking/framing that produced partial JSON and delimiter ordering issues
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation: Multiple customers and internal e2e tests surfaced a class of streaming regressions where SSE output could emit token/event fragments that resulted in partial JSON objects (broken structured output) or incorrect ordering of user-visible delimiter events. This manifests during high-throughput multi-chunk responses and when the OpenAI compatibility adapter performs additional framing for function/tool-calling payloads.

This PR fixes the root causes by: 1) introducing a deterministic chunk assembler that guarantees token-level ordering before framing into SSE events, 2) adding an explicit delimiter-state machine to ensure delimiter tokens (e.g. "\n\n") are attached to the correct event and not split across boundaries, and 3) normalizing event emission order so partial-json markers and final payload events arrive in the expected sequence for OpenAI-style streaming consumers.

Changes include tests and docs and are intentionally small and targeted: the runtime emitter change is isolated to the streaming layer; the openai-compat adapter now uses the emitter's new stable API rather than performing ad-hoc buffering. This should resolve customer reports of JSON parsing errors in structured-output flows and improve reliability for function/tool calling flows that rely on correct delimiter ordering.

Checklist: 
- [x] Add deterministic chunk assembler and state machine in emitter
- [x] Update OpenAI compatibility adapter to use stable emission API
- [x] Add unit + e2e test reproducing partial-JSON case
- [x] Update streaming docs and compatibility notes
- [x] Run CI and flakiness checks

Related: ENG-4721, previously-reported customer incident (SUP-9238).
commits: fix(streaming): deterministic token ordering and chunk assembler in sse emitter
fix(openai-compat): move framing to stable emitter API, avoid double-buffering
test(sse): add e2e test reproducing partial JSON + delimiter boundary cases
docs(streaming): document SSE framing guarantees and compat notes
chore(tests): add CI retry for flaky sse e2e test
review_conversation: Diego: Can you explain why the previous buffering approach caused ordering inversion under load?

Aisha: The previous approach performed framing at the adapter level while the emitter also flushed partial token buffers. Under concurrent flushes the emitter could interleave small token fragments. The chunk assembler centralizes ordering and owns flush semantics.
Hannah: Tests look good, but please add a regression e2e replicating the customer repro — done in test_sse_partial_json.py
Liam: Approving pending a small comment about a log level change — addressed
Diego: LGTM, verified local repro and CI.
merge_commit_summary: sse: deterministic chunking + delimiter-state-machine; openai-compat uses stable emitter API; tests/docs
release_notes: Fix: SSE streaming - prevent partial JSON/incorrect delimiter ordering in streaming responses. Improves reliability for OpenAI-compat streaming, function calling, and structured outputs.
